title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own delivery of complex, high-value programs for our largest US utility customers. This is a customer-facing role, where you will be the trusted point of contact for customer teams and executive sponsors. While our Customer Success team members will own technical excellence and delivering the value to customers, you will be accountable for delivering every program on time, to scope and to a standard of excellence that customers will remember.

You will be the connective tissue between Customer Success, Product and Engineering, and a champion for change with both customers - adopting new technology and ways of working - and inside Neara, as our delivery model evolves. That includes a relentless pursuit of ways to deliver more and larger customer projects with the same resources, using AI and automation to make our work faster, more consistent and more scalable.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

-
Lead end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of complex enterprise programs, from kickoff through go-live and adoption, involving large-scale data ingestion (LiDAR, GIS, asset data), model builds, integrations and value driven use cases

-
Be the primary point of contact for customer program teams and executive sponsors, building trusted relationships at every level

-
Run program governance, incl. steering committees, executive updates, status reporting & decision logs

-
Define scope, milestones, dependencies and success criteria, and keep programs on track by coordinating across Customer Success, Product and Engineering

-
Plan ahead for risks and dependencies, and guide stakeholders through key decisions with clear options and trade-offs

-
Champion change with customers through stakeholder alignment, training and adoption plans, so new workflows become part of how teams work

-
Apply and improve program management standards, templates and reporting across the US team

-
Identify opportunities to use AI and automation across the delivery lifecycle, such as status reporting, data validation and project setup, and help the team adopt them

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

-
5+ years in technical program or project management, delivering complex enterprise software, data or infrastructure programs

-
Significant customer-facing experience, comfortable leading the room with senior stakeholders and building lasting trust

-
A consistent record of delivering multi-stakeholder programs on time and to a high standard

-
A natural change leader who has helped customers and teams adopt new tools, processes or ways of working

-
Technical enough to go deep with engineers on data pipelines, integrations and cloud platforms. Python or SQL skills are highly regarded

-
Comfortable working at multiple altitudes: shaping program strategy with executives one day, unblocking execution on the ground the next

-
Confident with data, tooling and project management tools (e.g. Fibery, Jira, Asana), and a practical user of AI tools to improve how work gets done

-
Experience in utilities, energy, GIS or LiDAR is a plus but not essential

WHAT WE OFFER

-
A rare opportunity to run some of our most important US customer programs while shaping how we deliver in one of our fastest-growing markets

-
Work on technology that matters. Our digital twins are actively protecting energy grids from increasingly common extreme weather and structural failure

-
Strategic autonomy, paired with a collaborative culture where everyone, from engineering to leadership, is accessible and aligned on the same mission

-
Competitive compensation including ESOP, flexible working, and excellent PTO, healthcare and 401(k) programs

Admission Operations & Systems Analyst

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Admission Operations & Systems Analyst provides collaborative support and technical expertise to solve complex issues. Serves as a key member of the Enrollment Management Operations team by managing the CRM, validating data, processing application materials, and building reports. The Analyst also serves as a backup to the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, who oversees the data and technology for the office. The Analyst also provides administrative support as needed for the Office of Admission.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

CRM Management – 30%

- Serve as a Power User and independently problem-solve issues in Technolutions’ Slate CRM. Solve complex technical issues to increase operational functionality.

- Monitor business requirements, identify gaps in current functionality and features, suggest enhancements, and assist the Asst. Director of Admission Operations in building innovative new features to increase effectiveness of the CRM (Slate) for operational, recruitment, and marketing purposes.

- Input data into the CRM (Slate) with a high level of accuracy. Proactively and independently validate the accuracy and efficiency of data and integrations.

- Update and maintain prospect, inquiry, and applicant records.

- In collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, analyze, map, and import data into and out of the CRM (Slate) on a regular basis, including the Common Application, test scores, transcripts, external vendors, and other offices. Ensures operational integrity of imported and exported data.

- Work closely with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations in maintaining data integrity and quality, including identifying, developing, and deploying new ways to manage data and clean-up needs across the college’s information systems.

- Build, edit, and deploy complex emails and text communications in the CRM (Slate) in collaboration with the Associate Director of Marketing & Communications and the Assistant Director of Admission Operations. This includes creating and using templates, creating and editing conditional logic using Liquid Markup and Content Blocks, building and testing hyperlinks, creating and editing HTML/CSS code, and pulling complex data queries.

- Build, edit, and evaluate the functionality of events, templates, forms, and portals in the CRM (Slate), including conditional logic, design (using HTML/CSS and/or JavaScript), data mapping, and communications.

- In collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, manage the user experience, access, and development for internal staff, external office use, and prospective students in technology environments.

- Serve as a resource and internal expert for staff on CRM (Slate) systems. Provide training and maintain related training materials and documentation in collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations.

- In collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, develop in-depth knowledge of the university's recruitment, marketing, and technology landscape. Advise team members on the capabilities and limitations of systems; provide support, training, and share best practices.

- Attend local and out of state conferences as requested, foster continuous learning in both the CRM (Slate) and the higher education landscape, and evaluate new features for integration. (Approximately 1-2 conferences per year.)

Operations & Document Processing – 30%

- Validate documents and credentials received from applicants. Ensure authenticity and accuracy in all documents submitted to evaluate admission and enrollment (approximately 35,000 documents per year).

- Scan, index, and import documents into the CRM (Slate).

- Maintain extensive knowledge of application requirements. Serve as an expert to internal staff, prospective students, families, and school counselors for accepted document types, requirements for admission, and processing workflows and timelines.

- Oversee processing of the admission email account (approximately 8,000 emails a year). Provide support and training to student operations assistants.

- Manage 4 student Operations Assistants, including hiring, onboarding, and ongoing support. Students are expected to maintain accuracy in document processing, student, parent, and counselor communications, data cleanup, and data validation. Provide oversight on their work, regularly check their accuracy, and provide regular training.

- Support the coordination and deployment of shipments of recruitment materials, posters, acceptance packets, promotional merchandise, and other mail/packages as needed.

Reporting and Data Analysis – 30%

- Create, edit, and run complex data queries and reports in Slate, Microsoft Excel, and PowerBI.

- Maintain knowledge of institutional policies surrounding data maintenance, storage, and sharing. Ensure the CRM (Slate) and all related systems operate in compliance with federal and state law.

- Serve as a resource to current and potential students, campus representatives, and the public about data, materials, and processing.

- Work closely with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations to find, extract, analyze, model, project, synthesize, and present enrollment data and trends, with the goal of supporting decision-making regarding Pitzer College’s recruitment, admission, enrollment, and retention strategies.

- Fulfill requests for data and data analysis from various campus departments and external vendors with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

- Research and respond to ad hoc data requests and questions to support strategic decision-making; provide recommendations based on data findings.

- Collaborate with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations to review data and reports before they are published to ensure accuracy.

- Collaborate internally and with other offices in the planning, designing, and evaluation of surveys.

Other Duties – 10%

- Work internally and with ancillary offices to support technology adoption and use; enhance existing practices with improved processes to increase efficiency and effective use of resources.

- Generate and guide day-to-day projects for student operations assistants as needed.

- Assist with large on-campus events (preparation, coordination, staffing the event).

- Assist in maintaining the back office and inventory.

- Answer multi-line telephones and respond to broad questions about Pitzer College and the other Claremont Colleges.

- Provide back-up reception duties for the front desk as needed.

- Perform other related duties as requested.

- Advanced ability to understand and navigate a complex relational database and create complex data queries.

title: Senior FP&A Associate
description:
Madhive is the leading independent and fully customizable operating system built to help local media professionals build profitable, differentiated, and efficient businesses. Madhive empowers sales teams to extend their reach into streaming and connects local advertisers with the communities they serve. Madhive’s platform provides the unique ability to reach local audiences at national scale, with premium supply partnerships and end-to-end tools for planning, targeting, and measuring full-funnel campaign outcomes. Powering campaigns for over 30,000 small and medium businesses per day, Madhive is driving the evolution of local media.

Madhive is looking for a Senior FP&A Associate to join our Strategic Finance team in New York. The successful candidate will own core forecasting, reporting, and business partnering infrastructure, directly informing pricing, investments, and stakeholder reporting.

This is a builder's role. You will design and automate maturing financial processes, establish operational standards, and communicate complex insights clearly across the business.

You will report to the Director, Strategic Finance and partner closely with all the departmental leaders across the business.

This role is based out of our New York City headquarters at 225 Broadway. We operate on a hybrid model, and the ideal candidate will work from the NYC office 3 days per week as needed for team collaboration, close cycles, and planning sessions.

What You'll Do

Planning & Forecasting

-
Own the integrated operating model — maintain a multi-schedule three-statement model with scenario testing, clear source mappings, and documented logic changes.

-
Build the annual budget & planning cycle across revenue, OpEx, headcount, and cash alongside department heads.

-
Manage headcount and compensation planning, keeping forecasts reconciled with HRIS census and approved compensation structures.

-
Model revenue dynamics including platform fees vs. media pass-through, take rates, gross vs. net revenue, and AdTech unit economics.

-
Design the planning rhythm — establish budget-vs-actuals reviews, spend approval workflows, and monthly business reviews.

Reporting & Close

-
Support the monthly close alongside Accounting by preparing accruals, reviewing actuals, and analyzing variances.

-
Deliver monthly reporting packages with variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior periods.

-
Maintain system reconciliations, including NetSuite-to-Looker bridges with fully documented variance drivers.

-
Analyze profitability across products, business lines, customers, and channels.

-
Track core KPIs including ARR, NRR, gross/logo retention, cohort profitability, CAC payback, and gross margins.

-
Prepare stakeholder materials for Board, lender, and investor presentations, including debt covenant calculations.

Controls & Data Integrity

-
Ensure data accuracy by tying out deliverables against approved models and control totals before distribution.

-
Validate source data from NetSuite, Looker, Salesforce, and HR systems before model ingestion.

-
Maintain version control and document all formula, logic, and mapping updates across shared tools.

Business Partnering

-
Partner with department leaders across the organization to evaluate spend and stress-test assumptions.

-
Manage tech & AI economics — forecast cloud spend, build cost attribution tags, and track AI/LLM unit economics.

Systems, Automation & Data

-
Streamline FP&A workflows by optimizing ERP and planning systems to reduce manual processes.

-
Standardize metrics & reporting in collaboration with BI, Systems, and Accounting.

-
Document financial processes to ensure scalability, audit readiness, and continuity.

Who You Are

-
4–6 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, or consulting.

-
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a quantitative field.

-
Advanced financial modeling experience building integrated 3-statement models from scratch.

-
Strong control discipline with a proven track record of error-free, board-grade deliverables.

-
Solid GAAP knowledge and understanding of operational accounting dynamics.

-
Fluency in recurring revenue metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC payback, retention, cohort analysis).

-
Technical skills: SQL proficiency, advanced Excel/Sheets, and experience with BI tools.

Preferred

-
AdTech, MarTech, SaaS, or Media experience (CTV/programmatic focus is a plus).

-
High-growth or pre-IPO background building scalable financial processes.

-
Experience with Board and lender reporting or debt covenant tracking.

-
Big 4, investment banking, or consulting training.

-
Hands-on experience with ERPs/planning tools (NetSuite, Adaptive, Pigment, Anaplan).

You'd Be a Great Fit If

-
Detail-oriented with high accuracy standards and a strong self-check discipline.

-
Cross-functional influencer who can partner across teams to drive financial discipline.

-
Tech & AI-forward mindset to leverage modern tools for speed and deeper analysis.

-
Resourceful problem solver comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days

-
Master the business model, own core reporting deliverables, and establish model audit controls.

By the end of your first 6 months

-
Deliver reliable operating models, timely close reporting, and automated FP&A workflows.

Job Description:

The Private Cloud AI Sales Specialist is responsible for driving growth of HPE’s AI business across New England, the Mid-Atlantic, and the Carolinas. This is a highly visible, customer-facing sales role focused on helping organizations move from AI experimentation to production by delivering secure, scalable, enterprise-ready AI infrastructure and platforms.

This individual will serve as the AI sales specialist across the territory, partnering closely with Account Managers, technical specialists, services teams, partners, and executive leadership to identify, develop, and close strategic AI opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a hunter and business builder who is comfortable creating opportunities from the ground up, engaging C-level executives and technical leaders, and navigating complex enterprise sales cycles. They should understand how AI is changing enterprise infrastructure requirements and be able to connect customer initiatives around generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, data science, and accelerated computing to measurable business outcomes.

This role requires someone who can operate at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, hybrid cloud, software, and services while building trusted relationships with customers ranging from technical practitioners to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business executives.

Responsibilities:

- Own and drive the Private Cloud AI sales pipeline across New England, the Mid-Atlantic, and the Carolinas, with responsibility for pipeline creation, opportunity development, forecasting, and revenue attainment.
- Proactively identify and develop net-new AI opportunities through prospecting, account planning, executive engagement, workshops, customer events, partner activities, and targeted sales campaigns.
- Partner closely with Account Managers and extended sales teams to develop AI strategies within existing accounts while also identifying and landing new customers.
- Lead customer conversations around Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, and private/hybrid AI architectures.
- Help customers evaluate where AI workloads should run across private cloud, public cloud, colocation, and hybrid environments based on performance, security, governance, data gravity, and economics.
- Develop a strong understanding of customer AI initiatives, use cases, data environments, application requirements, and business priorities to create differentiated solutions.
- Engage with customers from technical practitioners through CIO, CTO, CDO, infrastructure, data, AI/ML, security, and business leadership.
- Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes including faster time to value, improved developer productivity, greater control of sensitive data, predictable AI economics, and lower total cost of ownership.
- Lead complex sales pursuits from initial discovery through technical validation, business-case development, solution design, commercial negotiation, and close.
- Coordinate internal resources including AI architects, solution engineers, services, finance, product teams, and executive sponsors to advance strategic opportunities.
- Work with customers to develop AI business cases and cloud-versus-private-AI economic models, including infrastructure utilization, GPU consumption, token economics, and workload growth.
- Drive customer workshops, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, hosted trials, benchmarks, and other technical validation activities when appropriate.
- Develop and maintain relationships with strategic partners across the AI ecosystem including NVIDIA, software vendors, ISVs, systems integrators, cloud providers, and channel partners.
- Maintain strong competitive awareness across AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, AI software, public cloud AI services, and emerging AI platforms.
- Accurately manage pipeline, opportunity progression, forecasting, and sales activity within the company's CRM and sales processes.
- Maintain current knowledge of rapidly evolving AI technologies, models, architectures, and market trends and translate those developments into actionable customer conversations.
- Act as an AI subject-matter expert and thought leader for customers, partners, and internal sales teams across the assigned territory.

Education and Experience Required:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent directly related professional experience.
- Typically 8+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably involving complex infrastructure, cloud, software, data, AI, or platform solutions.
- Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and successfully closing complex enterprise opportunities.
- Proven experience prospecting, hunting, and creating net-new business, rather than relying exclusively on existing pipeline.
- Experience working collaboratively with Enterprise Account Managers in a specialist or overlay sales model.
- Experience engaging senior executives and technical decision-makers within mid-market and large enterprise organizations.
- Experience selling AI, Cloud, hybrid cloud, infrastructure, platform, or as-a-service solutions.
- Experience developing business cases and positioning technology based on business value, economics, risk reduction, and strategic outcomes.
- Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

Knowledge and Skills:

- Strong understanding of the rapidly evolving enterprise AI, Generative AI, and Agentic landscape.
- Understanding of AI infrastructure concepts including GPUs, accelerated computing, high-performance networking, storage, data platforms, and AI workload requirements.
- Familiarity with the AI/ML lifecycle including model development, training, fine-tuning, inference, deployment, monitoring, and governance.
- Working knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, model serving, model routing/gateways, Kubernetes, containers, APIs, Tokenomics, and modern AI application architectures.
- Understanding of private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid-cloud architectures and the tradeoffs associated with performance, security, governance, sovereignty, and cost.
- Ability to discuss AI economics, including public-cloud consumption models, infrastructure utilization, GPU requirements, and the potential business case for private AI.
- Strong understanding of enterprise security, governance, data privacy, and compliance considerations associated with AI adoption.
- Knowledge of the competitive AI ecosystem, including infrastructure vendors, cloud providers, AI platforms, model providers, and emerging AI software companies.
- Ability to translate highly technical concepts into clear business value for executive audiences.
- Strong discovery, consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
- Ability to build consensus across multiple customer stakeholders and manage complex sales pursuits.
- Strong account-planning, pipeline-management, and forecasting discipline.
- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving market where technologies, competitors, customer requirements, and business models are evolving rapidly.
- High level of curiosity and a demonstrated commitment to continuously learning about emerging AI technologies and their implications for enterprise customers.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted AI advisor to customers and account teams while consistently creating new opportunities and converting strategic AI initiatives into revenue.

The strongest candidates will combine enterprise sales discipline, technical curiosity, executive presence, and a hunter mentality. They will be equally comfortable discussing an AI strategy with a CIO, understanding desired business outcomes, working through GPU and platform requirements with an AI engineering team, building an economic justification with finance, and coordinating the resources necessary to move a complex opportunity from concept to production.

title: VP of Product
description:
About the role:

Curri is seeking a VP of Product to lead and scale the product organization as it enters its next stage of growth. This leader will set a bold, customer-backed vision for an AI-native logistics platform, bring ROI rigor to how we size and prioritize bets, grow the PM team, and be the face of Curri's roadmap in front of customers.

What you will do:

-
Set and own Curri's product vision and roadmap.

-
Bake AI into the core of the product so it feels native, not bolted on. No chat sidebars or sparkle buttons. AI should quietly take over the dispatch, routing, pricing, and support decisions people make by hand today, inside the workflows they already use.

-
Build ROI discipline into the roadmap by putting a value on every opportunity and prioritizing against it, the way Sales manages pipeline value. For automation, that means valuing bets by the ops work they remove.

-
Close the loop on every bet: define success metrics before building, instrument what ships, and compare actual results against the original estimate. Use that track record to sharpen future sizing.

-
Work with the executive team to turn company strategy into a focused, prioritized product plan, and represent that plan to leadership.

-
Partner with Engineering as a true thought partner to work through trade-offs, drive execution, and ship on fast cycles.

-
Stay close to customers so you understand their workflows and the decisions the platform needs to power. Evangelize the roadmap through customer advisory boards, key account conversations, and joint pitches with Sales that build excitement and help close deals.

-
Get on sales calls for strategic deals. Run product demos, handle product objections and gaps directly, and help shape what we commit to in enterprise contracts. Bring win/loss patterns back into the roadmap.

-
Own quality for AI-driven features, including evals, failure modes, cost, and latency, and the guardrails customers need before they trust automation in their operations.

-
Set the bar for how the PM team works with AI: prototyping with AI tools instead of writing long specs, and moving from idea to working demo in days.

-
Lead and grow the product management team from three PMs today toward four to six, spending most of your time on leadership and cross-functional work with Engineering, Growth, Operations, and the exec team.

What you need to have:

-
10+ years in product, including 4+ years managing product managers, with a track record of growing into product leadership where the title reflected real scope.

-
Strong conviction as a product visionary: you form a clear point of view on where the product should go, ground it in customer evidence, and hold it steady against competing priorities.

-
Real energy for customer-facing work, from running customer advisory boards to pitching the roadmap alongside Sales, with the ability to leave customers excited about what is coming.

-
Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles, including demos, product objections, RFPs, and security or integration reviews, with a track record of helping close deals without overcommitting the roadmap.

-
Business and ROI rigor: experience building business cases for product investments and using opportunity sizing to make and defend prioritization calls.

-
Strong product analytics instincts. You can define the metrics that matter, pull your own data from tools like PostHog or SQL, and run experiments and staged rollouts without waiting on a BI team.

-
Shipped AI or ML features to production that users experienced as part of the product rather than a separate add-on, and stayed with them after launch through the messy parts: evals, edge cases, and adoption.

-
Personal fluency with current AI tools. You use them every day, build prototypes yourself, and have opinions on what is hype and what is leverage.

-
A hands-on leadership style that pairs executive communication and cross-functional influence with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and do the work alongside the team, rather than managing from a distance.

Bonus points for:

-
Product leadership experience at a marketplace company.

-
Having built agentic or automation products in operations-heavy domains like logistics, marketplaces, or field services.

-
Having built or scaled a product org at a similar growth stage.

-
Having brought a new layer of discipline, such as ROI modeling or opportunity sizing, to a product team that lacked it.

What is in it for you?

-
Real space to shape, or overhaul, the roadmap of an AI-native platform, with big bets ahead in automation, internationalization, and expansion into new verticals.

-
The chance to build and scale the PM team as a true peer to Engineering and Growth leadership.

-
Competitive salary, equity compensation, and comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401K).

-
Remote-friendly with preference for Ventura, CA office presence.

-
A high-growth, mission-driven environment where your work has direct and measurable impact.

Who are we?

We are Curri, and our mission is to build the network and software that move the world’s goods with speed, intelligence, and trust. Curri provides on-demand, last-mile logistics for construction and adjacent industries with our nationwide fleet of cars, trucks, and flatbeds.
Founded in 2018 and part of the YC S19 Batch, we’re solving the massive inefficiencies that exist in the construction industry. Our headquarters are in Ventura, CA. Learn more at curri.com.

Curri is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

As a Detection & Automation Engineer III, you will play a key role in enhancing our ability to identify, investigate, and respond to cybersecurity threats across cloud, identity, endpoint, database, and application environments.

This position blends DevOps, detection engineering, SIEM administration, telemetry engineering, and data integration to improve security visibility and strengthen our threat detection program. You'll work closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to build scalable detection capabilities, onboard critical security telemetry, and drive continuous improvements across our security operations ecosystem.

- Administer and optimize Splunk Enterprise Security, including ES frameworks, data models, reporting, dashboards, and search performance.

- Develop and maintain security logging standards, monitoring controls, and data quality processes.
- Design monitoring capabilities for enterprise databases and business-critical applications, focusing on privileged access, authentication activity, anomalous behavior, and sensitive data access.
- Contribute to Detection-as-Code initiatives through version control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and reusable detection frameworks.
- Track and improve key metrics including detection coverage, alert fidelity, telemetry health, and operational effectiveness.
- Drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce false positives, improve detection accuracy, and streamline security operations.

- Strong understanding of security monitoring, log management, telemetry engineering, and threat detection methodologies.

- Experience supporting cybersecurity monitoring and logging requirements within regulated environments.
- Background in database administration, enterprise data engineering, or large-scale telemetry architectures.
- Experience implementing Detection-as-Code methodologies and security automation solutions.
- Knowledge of audit logging standards, security monitoring controls, and modern security observability practices.
- Relevant industry certifications such as Splunk Core Certified Power User, Splunk Enterprise Certified Administrator, GIAC, CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent.

title: PILLAR Business Manager
description:

Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The PILLAR Business Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation of the Firm’s AI-enabled legal production service, managing the flow of work from intake and scoping through delivery, measurement, and follow-up. This role ensures that AI-enabled legal assignments are appropriately scoped, staffed, scheduled, documented, and integrated with the Firm’s commercial, financial, and matter-management processes. Working at the intersection of legal practice, technology, eDiscovery, finance, and client delivery, the PILLAR Business Manager partners with attorneys, legal professionals, technologists, and business teams to establish and maintain efficient, scalable operating processes. The role requires strong operational judgment and the ability to create structure within a rapidly evolving environment while maintaining clear accountability, service standards, and appropriate attorney oversight. The PILLAR Business Manager facilitates the operational processes supporting AI-enabled legal work but does not determine legal strategy, make final privilege decisions, validate legal conclusions, accept work product on behalf of a responsible attorney, make compensation or credit determinations, or independently establish pricing. The role is responsible for ensuring that appropriate stakeholders make required decisions and that assignments, approvals, documentation, and related processes move forward effectively.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Manage the intake process for AI-enabled legal production requests, translating requests into clearly documented assignments with defined scope, intended use, source requirements, participants, timelines, dependencies, deliverables, and commercial considerations.

· Coordinate Legal AI Operators, Evidence Operations, case team members, validators, responsible attorneys, and other contributors throughout the assignment lifecycle while maintaining appropriate roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and attorney oversight.

· Manage the active portfolio of AI-enabled legal assignments, including capacity, prioritization, deadlines, dependencies, handoffs, delivery commitments, refresh requests, exceptions, and escalations.

· Maintain the product and assignment pipeline and provide visibility into demand, status, forecast, repeat use, adoption, delivery history, and emerging operational needs.

· Partner with Pricing, Finance, Billing, and matter teams to support consistent quoting, matter setup, measurement, and billing processes and ensure appropriate follow-through on required commercial and financial activities.

· Maintain complete and accurate operational records, including source boundaries, workflow status, validation, responsible-attorney acceptance, release, delivery, refresh, and supersession documentation.

· Track and analyze operational performance, including effort, cycle time, defects, remediation, variance, capacity, and lessons learned, and translate findings into improvements to products, workflows, procedures, and service delivery.

· Develop and maintain concise dashboards and management reporting that provide program leadership and Firm management with visibility into demand, capacity, delivery, adoption, operational performance, exceptions, and unresolved decisions.

· Support adoption of the Firm’s AI-enabled legal production capabilities by helping partners and case teams identify appropriate uses, understand available services, and effectively navigate intake, execution, and delivery processes.

· Maintain accurate participation and utilization records to support Firm reporting, program evaluation, and applicable recognition processes.

· Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve operating procedures, service standards, workflows, escalation paths, controls, and cross-functional responsibilities as the Legal AI program evolves and expands.

· Establish clear ownership, deadlines, dependencies, and status visibility across active assignments to promote accountability and timely delivery.

· Facilitate consistent handoffs among pricing, matter setup, production, validation, responsible-attorney acceptance, delivery, and billing processes, ensuring that required documentation is complete and appropriate stakeholders are engaged.

· Identify operational risks, gaps, bottlenecks, and unresolved decisions and coordinate appropriate escalation and resolution.

· Use insights and lessons learned from completed assignments to drive measurable improvements in service delivery, procedures, training, workflows, and future AI-enabled legal products.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

- Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience in service operations, program management, project management, legal operations, professional services, or a comparable client-delivery environment.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex and concurrent workstreams involving competing priorities, deadlines, interdependent teams, and senior stakeholders.

- Strong operational judgment and demonstrated ability to clarify ambiguous requests, identify missing information or decisions, manage exceptions, resolve operational issues, and escalate matters appropriately.

- Working knowledge of financial and operational concepts, including pricing, cost, utilization, realization, variance, forecasting, and capacity planning.

- Demonstrated experience developing and implementing processes, maintaining reliable operational records, and using data, metrics, dashboards, and reporting to evaluate and improve service delivery.

- Strong organizational and project-management capabilities, with demonstrated attention to detail and the ability to manage assignments from intake through completion.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex operational matters clearly and concisely with partners, attorneys, technologists, business professionals, and Firm leadership.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across legal, technical, financial, and operational functions while maintaining clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making authority.

- High level of discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment in handling confidential client, personnel, financial, and Firm information.

- Ability to operate effectively in a rapidly evolving environment, establish structure where processes are still developing, and adapt operating practices as business and technology requirements change.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience working within an AmLaw law firm, corporate legal department, eDiscovery organization, litigation support function, legal technology company, or technology-enabled professional services environment.

- Experience launching, operationalizing, standardizing, or scaling a new service, product line, innovation program, technology-enabled offering, or center of excellence.

title: Postdoctoral Researcher - AI for Earth System Sciences

Contributes technical expertise through analysis and support for programs and projects associated with machine learning, HPC, and computational problems related to earth system science and other dynamical systems. Development, evaluation, and applying machine learning/computational approaches, synthesis activities, computational tools, compiling results, preparing reports, publications, and documentation. title: Senior Manager, Fraud Strategy & Operations
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Fraud and Risk Operations team safeguards Raisin’s U.S. business by monitoring, detecting, and mitigating risks across the customer lifecycle. We manage fraud prevention, investigations, payments risk, fraud recovery, and while supporting 2nd line AML/KYC oversight. It partners closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Customer Service to ensure safe and frictionless customer experiences. As a multi-bank deposit marketplace targeting rapid growth, Raisin faces complex, evolving multi-vector fraud challenges across onboarding, identity verification, bank linking, and money movement. Fraud and Risk Operations is at the center of designing the strategies, controls, and analytical foundations that protect the platform at scale.

Your Responsibilities

This role directly reports to the Head of Fraud Operations and is a senior expert role at Raisin US. We are looking for a Fraud Operations Specialist to assist in the design, building, and optimizing our fraud prevention and detection framework. In this role, you will be responsible for creating both predictive (pre-transaction/real-time mitigation) and detective (post-transaction/monitoring) rules within our risk platform. You will analyze emerging fraud patterns, balance fraud mitigation with user friction, and collaborate with product, engineering, payments, service and other allied teams to protect the Raisin platform and its customers while optimizing transaction approval rates.

Predictive & Preventative Strategy (Real-Time Rules)

- Real-Time Rule Authoring: Design, test, and deploy real-time logic within the risk rules engine (e.g., velocity checks, device fingerprinting triggers, IP risk thresholds, and behavioral anomalies, etc.) to intercept fraudulent actions during the entire customer lifecycle.

- Risk Model Integration: Partner with internal and external platform partners to integrate, build and implement both customer and transaction level fraud scores into the rules engine, creating conditional logic that automatically approves, blocks, or challenges high-risk events.

- Friction Optimization: Monitor and optimize false positive rates to ensure legitimate customer transactions pass through with minimal friction.

Detective & Post-Transaction Strategy (Monitoring & Analysis)

- Behavioral & Batch Monitoring: Build detective monitoring rules, threshold alerts, and transaction reports to identify complex fraud patterns, first party fraud triggers, account takeover, synthetic ID, or coordinated fraud rings after events occur.

- Chargeback & Loss Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct post-mortems on confirmed fraud instances and Reg E disputes to identify gaps in existing rule sets and rapidly deploy backtest-verified countermeasures.

- Rule Performance Tuning: Regularly review, backtest, and refine active rules to eliminate stale logic, reduce redundancy, and adapt to shifting fraud tactics. Utilize the iterations of rules to also actively monitor the existing customer book.

- Rules and telemetry expansion: Active work internally and externally to seek additional risk signals, and proactively deploy to stay ahead of emerging fraud patterns.

Fraud Strategy & Operations

- Responsible for partnering with the Head of Fraud to own and execute Raisin’s U.S. fraud strategy across onboarding, account linking, and payment flows.

- Design and refine fraud policies, rules, controls, and escalation processes.

- Lead fraud investigations end-to-end and translate findings into durable controls.

- Build fraud KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting for leadership.

- Quantify fraud exposure, loss trends, and efficiency metrics to inform strategic decisions.

Fraud Modeling & Advanced Analytics

- Own the roadmap for fraud models across the customer lifecycle.

- Build and maintain customer risk profiling and scoring frameworks and enhance monitoring of high-risk customers.

- Design, implement, and deploy machine learning models for anomaly detection, identity risk, behavioral analytics, and transaction monitoring.

- Build features from device, behavioral, graph, identity, ACH/payment telemetry, and network data.

- Partner with Engineering and Data to ensure high-quality data pipelines for real-time model scoring.

- Translate model outputs into practical decision strategies (rules, thresholds, step-up flows).

Your Profile

- 8+ years in fraud risk management, fraud analytics, fraud data science, AML/financial crime, or payments risk (fintech, digital banking, payments a strong plus).

- Strong technical skills: Python, SQL, and experience with feature engineering, model development, and fraud analytics.

- Proven ability to design, deploy, and monitor machine learning models in production.

- Deep familiarity with U.S. fraud typologies: identity fraud, mule activity, ATO, synthetic IDs, ACH fraud, bank linking fraud, and payment abuse.

- Understanding of AML/KYC frameworks and how they intersect with fraud controls.

- Experience influencing decisions across Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to executive leadership.

- Strategic, analytical mindset with a focus on balancing fraud prevention, operations scalability, and customer experience.

- Leadership experience, formal or informal, and ability to scale influence across teams.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
About Niantic Spatial

At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment.

Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets - building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens.

About the Role

We're hiring software engineering interns for Summer 2027; each intern will be embedded in a specialized track. You won't be shadowing or running demos - you'll own a real problem on a small team, write code that ships to production, and work on systems and datasets that don't exist anywhere else: petabyte-scale 3D reconstructions, foundation models trained on physical space, and positioning infrastructure deployed globally.

Select your primary track when you apply. We'll match you based on fit; switching tracks after matching is uncommon but possible if there's strong mutual interest.

Track 1: ML /AI Infrastructure

You'll build the systems that make large-scale physical AI possible. Not just run experiments, but design the distributed training pipelines, data ingestion infrastructure, and GPU optimization layers that let us train foundation models on billions of images and 3D data points.

-
Model Training with PyTorch — Implement, train, and evaluate model architectures in PyTorch, iterating on data loaders, loss functions, and training loops to improve model quality and convergence on real production datasets.

-
Training Infrastructure — Design and scale distributed training pipelines for our Large Geospatial Model, handling petabyte-scale spatial data across multi-GPU and multi-node environments.

-
Data Pipelines — Build high-throughput ingestion and preprocessing pipelines that transform raw imagery and 3D point clouds into training-ready datasets.

-
Observability — Instrument training runs with metrics, dashboards, and alerting so engineering teams can debug and iterate faster.

Best for: Students obsessed with the intersection of ML and systems - PyTorch, distributed computing (Ray, Spark), CUDA, and high-performance architecture.

Track 2: Product Engineering

You'll build the product APIs and services that sit behind our spatial computing products, helping customers manage projects, organize spatial data, upload content, and turn it into useful experiences. You'll work across backend and product engineering to take features from design to production, with a focus on clear interfaces, reliable workflows, and software that other teams can build on.

-
Product Features — Build and ship features for managing organizations, projects, spatial data, and content.

-
API Design — Design the interfaces that connect our products, web and mobile applications, and developer tools, making them consistent, well-documented, and easy to use.

-
Workflows & Integrations — Connect the steps behind core product workflows, from uploading and processing data to making results available to users and applications.

-
End-to-End Delivery — Collaborate with engineers across frontend, backend, and infrastructure to launch features and learn from real customer use.

Best for: Students who enjoy building products from the backend up and interested in how APIs and data power user experiences. Motivated by shipping software that real customers and developers use.

Track 3: Backend Systems

You'll build and harden the high-throughput services that power our Visual Positioning System and reconstruction platform - processing vast volumes of visual data and delivering centimeter-level positioning to users and robots globally.

-
Service Development — Design and ship microservices in Go or C++ that sit in the critical path of our positioning and reconstruction APIs.

-
Data Ingestion — Build and optimize pipelines that ingest, validate, and route large volumes of visual and sensor data from diverse hardware sources.

-
Performance & Reliability — Profile service bottlenecks, improve latency, and improve system observability through structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

-
API Design — Contribute to internal and external API design, writing clean, well-tested, production-grade interfaces that other teams and customers depend on.

Best for: Pragmatic engineers who care about correctness, performance, and clean systems design and want to see their code serving real traffic within weeks.

What You'll Bring (All Tracks)

-
Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Vision, or a related field.

-
TypeScript, Python, C++ or Go experience for Infrastructure and Backend tracks.

-
Genuine curiosity about how AI interacts with the physical world - 3D reconstruction, spatial reasoning, or real-world positioning systems.

Ability to work independently, debug ambiguous problems, and communicate clearly with a small team.

Available for 4 days per week in our San Francisco office for the full 12-week internship.

This internship is based in our San Francisco, CA office. We work in a high-collaboration environment and ask interns to be on-site a minimum of 4 days per week. To make that easy, we provide lunch every day and snacks are always stocked.

title: Customer Support Developer (Databases)
description:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.

We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.

Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

The Role:

Are you the kind of developer who gets a rush from cracking a gnarly replication bug, an issue with CDC implementation, or a query that hangs with no obvious reason? Do you thrive at the intersection of writing code and helping customers succeed? As a Customer Support Developer (Databases) at Airbyte, you'll combine hands-on development skills with deep technical empathy to support our growing cloud, embedded, and open-source integration platform.

This isn't a traditional support role. You'll be writing Java and Kotlin, shipping contributions to our open-source database source and destination connectors, digging into query plans and transaction logs, and directly shaping how customers move mission-critical data between databases, warehouses, and lakes. You'll champion the customer voice alongside our engineering and product teams every day, getting your hands dirty in the code.

What You’ll Do:

Customer Support & Technical Troubleshooting

-
Serve as the primary technical escalation point for database-related customer issues, responding via email, ticketing systems, and video calls with precision and clarity.

-
Triage and prioritize incoming issues with urgency, consistently meeting SLA targets while leveraging AI tools to work smarter and resolve issues faster.

-
Dig into complex issues across relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, and cloud object storage, not just finding workarounds but partnering with Engineering to root-cause and drive real fixes.

-
Reproduce customer-reported bugs by inspecting connector logs, query plans, replication slots, transaction logs, sync state, and destination table state, and document findings with enough technical detail for Engineering to act on immediately.

-
Support customers through onboarding and troubleshooting for SSH tunnels, network configuration, database user permissions, CDC setup (WAL/binlog/redo logs), and warehouse/lake authentication.

Database Connector Development

-
Get hands-on with customers building and debugging integrations, helping them navigate Airbyte's database sources and destinations with confidence, from authentication and SSL/SSH setup to CDC, schema evolution, incremental cursors, and typed destination tables.

-
Validate database version compatibility across supported engines and releases, maintain testing environments, and reproduce customer-reported behavior on real database and warehouse instances.

-
Support customers writing to data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), data lakes and object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Databricks, Iceberg), and databases (Postgres, MySQL, MSSQL, ClickHouse), including schema evolution and typed-columns behavior.

-
Help customers running database sources (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and more) troubleshoot replication behavior, cursor selection, full-refresh vs. incremental vs. CDC trade-offs, and sync state recovery.

title: Corporate Account Executive
description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

About the Role: We are seeking a driven individual who is passionate about new business acquisition and enterprise sales. As a Corporate Account Executive, you will be responsible for executing a strategic sales plan within your assigned territory, focusing on revenue growth and new customer acquisition. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including solution engineering (pre-sales), marketing, and professional services, to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success.

Candidates must be based in the Greater NYC area to be considered for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute a strategic territory plan targeting key organizations and applicable use cases to build a robust pipeline and achieve quarterly and annual sales objectives.

- Become an expert in our product offerings and industry solutions, delivering compelling demos, presentations, and proposals that clearly articulate business value.

- Leverage deep knowledge of the market to position our solutions as the best fit for customer needs, highlighting the advantages over competing technologies and approaches.

- Lead complex sales cycles with a solution-based approach, employing strategic selling strategies and tactics, including the Land & Expand model to grow accounts.

- Manage the full sales process from prospecting to closing, consistently securing new logos and expanding within existing accounts.

- Provide guidance and mentorship to Business Development Representatives (BDRs) and Field Marketing resources to align on target accounts and support pipeline development.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the CRM system, ensuring data integrity and adhering to forecasting guidelines.

- Develop strong partnerships with public cloud providers (AWS, Google, Microsoft Azure) and leverage these relationships to drive growth opportunities.

What You Bring to the Role:

- 3+ years of proven success in commercial software sales with a consistent track record of exceeding targets.

- Demonstrated experience managing complex sales processes within enterprise markets such as Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science, AI/ML, or related fields.

- Proven ability to independently develop and close new client relationships while effectively managing long-term business engagements.

- Deep understanding of commercial open-source business models, including selling on-premise and cloud & SaaS hybrid solutions.

- Ability to craft and execute sales strategies tailored to specific industries, leveraging partner and Go-to-Market knowledge.

- Strong presentation, communication, and organizational skills with a knack for building strong business champions.

- Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, SPIN, or Challenger Sales, and experience working in a fast-paced, competitive market.

- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver on customer expectations, including Pre-Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Field Engineering resources.

- Proven ability to build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers, including CTOs, IT leaders, and technical end users, while collaborating with Solution Architects, Professional Services, and Channel Partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience selling complex technical solutions, with a focus on subscription-based models and cloud deployments.

- Knowledge of graph technology, data management tools, or other advanced data-driven technologies.

- A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and proficiency in standard corporate productivity tools (Google Docs, Salesforce, MS Office).

Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

title: Marketing Operations Manager (Contract)
description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the systems behind our marketing programs and connect them to the BDR and sales teams so they run as one motion rather than a series of handoffs. When Marketing launches a program, this person makes sure it's built, QA'd, and lands cleanly with reps. When a BDR identifies an opportunity, this person makes sure the data, lists, and programs behind it are ready to act on immediately. The quality and completeness of our GTM data is what makes that speed possible, and as we expand into new segments and apply more AI and automation across the revenue engine, that foundation matters more every quarter.

You'll join a Revenue Operations team that has built the core routing, enrichment, and funnel infrastructure, and you'll have room to improve each of them. Because marketing systems feed directly into the sales process, you'll also partner with Sales and BDR teams on Salesforce work that keeps pipeline moving, and help harden routing, enrichment, and data hygiene alongside the rest of RevOps.

This role is built for someone who ramps fast and runs independently. With documented systems and SOPs to lean on, you'll be expected to own your queue within your first 30–45 days and make sound calls without waiting for sign-off. Day-to-day operational support is a real part of the job, but the greater impact comes from identifying and building durable, scalable solutions that drive revenue. The ideal candidate builds strong relationships across Sales, Marketing, and BDR leadership, treats data as a strategic asset, and consistently prioritizes the work with the greatest business impact.

This is a contractor role with opportunity to convert to full time hire.

How You'll Make an Impact:

-
Own Market program operations end to end, including builds, templates, segmentation, scoring, and QA. This covers campaigns, events, direct mail, and BDR-driven outreach, so programs launch cleanly and hand off to reps without friction.

-
Operate and evolve inbound lead routing, assignment logic, and enrichment with the broader RevOps team. Keep rules accurate as territories and segments change, and make sure records arrive complete enough for a rep to act on.

-
Build and scale foundational ops architecture across our stack, including lead lifecycle and account funnel models, lead status, and deduplication and RingLead matching rules.

-
Serve as the operational partner to Sales and BDR teams on Salesforce requests, record hygiene, and reporting, turning recurring asks into repeatable workflows.

-
Identify and ship improvements across our marketing stack that increase pipeline, improve speed to lead, or make Sales and Marketing more efficient.

-
Prioritize incoming requests from Marketing, Sales, and BDR leadership, and communicate tradeoffs directly when capacity is constrained.

What Makes You a Good Fit:

-
5+ years in Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations, including hands-on Salesforce work supporting Sales and BDR teams and systems ownership rather than campaign execution alone.

-
Deep hands-on Marketo experience, including program architecture, smart lists, scoring, and the Salesforce sync.

-
A track record of driving measurable outcomes through systems and data work, such as faster lead response, higher inbound conversion, or better pipeline visibility.

-
A builder's orientation toward scalable solutions, with examples of turning recurring operational issues into durable processes or automation while still managing day-to-day demands.

-
You drive work forward rather than waiting for it. Given an outcome, you define the problem, propose the approach, flag risks early, and ship.

-
Strong Salesforce administration skills, including objects and relationships, field architecture, validation rules, flows, and reporting.

-
Practical Clay experience, including waterfall enrichment and Salesforce writeback, and comfort working with data outside the UI through SQL, scripting, or spreadsheets at scale.

-
A data steward's mindset. You notice when a field is misused, fix root causes rather than symptoms, document systems as you build them, and treat record quality as a shared asset.

-
Proven ability to build strong relationships across stakeholder groups with competing priorities, and the judgment to focus effort where it matters most.

Preferred Qualifications:

-
Familiarity with Palantir Foundry, or a warehouse-centric reporting stack that feeds GTM systems.

-
Outreach, LeanData, RingLead, or Gong administration experience.

-
Experience applying AI and workflow automation to GTM operations, whether through Clay, Zapier, n8n, or LLM-based enrichment and classification.

-
Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Compensation: This is a temporary independent contractor (1099) position with an initial contract duration of six (6) months, with the potential to extend or evolve based on business needs and mutual fit. The hourly rate range for this contract is $75 – $130* per hour and will vary based on factors including skill level, relevant experience, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and geographic location. This position is not eligible for company-sponsored benefits. As an independent contractor, the individual is solely responsible for maintaining any required liability insurance, other applicable insurance coverage, benefits, and for the payment of all applicable federal, state, and local taxes.
